title: Boundary-Packet Source Absorption Theorem
active_obstruction: semilocal Delta_S positive part on shifted Sonin boundary sector

main_objects.source_frame: F_n = sum lambda_{omega,n} Q_omega^* Theta_omega^{-1} Q_omega
main_objects.source_gate: Pi_B F_n Pi_B >= Lambda_n Pi_B Theta_0^{-1} Pi_B - R_n^B

main_theorem: If Delta_S^+ <= c_B Pi_B + K_S and the source frame gives a divergent lower frame on B_S with compact/tail defects controlled, then Delta_S^+ is absorbed by F_n up to vanishing defects.
next_step: Extract the Heap-Soundararajan dual-mollifier bilinear form and test an operator-valued lift on a finite Sonine boundary-packet model.
